about.title: Travel that weighs what matters
about.intro: EcoRoute plans journeys that balance the experiences you want against the time, cost, and environmental footprint they carry — so the trade-offs are visible, not hidden.

plan.title: Plan with intention
plan.description: Tell us where, when, and what matters most to you — we'll shape a set of real itinerary options around it.

footprint.title: Understand your footprint
footprint.description: Every itinerary shows its estimated environmental impact alongside cost and time, so it's part of the decision, not an afterthought.

assistant.title: A travel companion
assistant.description: Ask the EcoRoute Assistant to adjust your plan, compare options, or explain a recommendation in plain language.

honest.title: Never fabricated
honest.description: Where live data genuinely exists — routes, locations, hotel identities, exchange rates — we use it. Where it doesn't, we say so plainly instead of guessing.

methodology.title: How EcoRoute works
methodology.intro: For the curious: the technical approach behind the recommendations.

optimization.definition: Each itinerary is ranked across carbon, cost, time, and your stated preference at once, rather than optimizing for a single number.

emissions.definition: Carbon estimates are built from published DEFRA 2023 and ICAO emission factors, not guesses — every figure is traceable to its source.

explanations.definition: An AI model turns the computed numbers behind each recommendation into a short, readable rationale.
